content: Hharan Shini Biereini Bilazho
"Hhe shihoude asiman gojia hoxian hharan shini bierei zhula bareidene shini khughonyi jienliekui xianli.
Hhelai dunda tawun benni, tawun jienzhani wo.
Tawun bennila zhula bareidene tosun ese bareizho.
Tawun jienzhanila zhula bareidene hulude tosun bareizho.
Shini khughon udazhi da ese irese hhela man nokuzhi kijie hhunturawo.
Banyedei kunla waradazho, 'Bosizhendu! Shini khughon irewo! Ghujighan jienliele khizhendu!'
Shini biereila man bosizhedene zhulalane zhendunlawo.
Bennila jienzhanilade kieliewo, 'Tosunsene gouji ogi, zhulabijienyi xiniene giezho.'
Jienzhanila kieliewo, 'Ulie olune. Manlade injizhi ulie kurune. Ta huisan kunlase agile echi.'
Hhela agile echikude shini khughon irewo. Zhunbei gie goudaghasanla shini khughonre hhantu ghurunde echise wijienyi khawo.
Khuinashi psedu shini biereila iredene kieliewo, 'Ezhan, Ezhan, bijiende wijienyi nieya!'
Shini khughon kieliewo, 'Bi tande shuhua kielieye, bi tai tani dane.'
Ingiese ta jinxin gie, hhe udu, hhe zhuntouni ta ulie mejiene."
Ghuran Hojini Bilazho
"Asiman gojia hoxian nie kun gholode echine giezhi hojilane uruzhi ire baerne hhelade jiuizhi gonjighakui xianli.
Zhao hhelai benshizhe niede 500 antan, niede 200 antan, niede 100 antan ogidene gholode echiwo.
500 linlasan deigo echidene meimei giezhi 500 zhenjiwo.
200 linlasanye 200 zhenjiwo.
100 linlasan echidene zeminde oko wai ezhanne baerni niuighawo.
Hende oloncha beidene ezhanni ire hhelase zhan sanazho.
500 linlasan ezhanne shida ire zhenjisan 500 ne bareizhi kieliewo, 'Ezhan, chi made 500 ogiwo. Uzhe, bi pse 500 zhenjiwo.'
Ezhanni kieliewo, 'Giesan gou wo. Chishi gou, kekaotu hoji wo. Ga shiqinde shixinji giezho, bi chii olon shiqinlai gonjighane. Ezhanghalane hhantu bayasu.'
200 linlasan ire kieliewo, 'Ezhan, chi made 200 ogiwo. Uzhe, bi pse 200 zhenjiwo.'
Ezhanni kieliewo, 'Giesan gou wo. Chishi gou, kekaotu hoji wo. Ga shiqinde shixinji giezho. Bi chii olon shiqinlai gonjighane. Ezhanghalane hhantu bayasu.'
100 linlasan ire kieliewo, 'Ezhan, chishi jiafatu kun bikui bi mejiene. Ese tareisan oronse ghurane, ese shizhisan oronse hhantulaghane.
Bi ayizhi echidene chii 100 ni zeminde niuighawo. Uzhe, chii miengu enende wo.'
Ezhanni hhende kieliewo, 'Chi ene doghun, langantu hoji, bi ese tareisan oronse ghurane, ese shizhisan oronse hhantulaghakui chi mejiese
mii baerni inhande jiekuni wo, bi irekude benqien lixiji agi khizhene.
Ta hhei baerlani agi echidene hhe 1000 bisande ogi.
Bichen kunlade pse olon ogizhi feilieghane, wichen kunlase bisanlainiye agi echine.
Ene yama zoin witu hojini ghadanedu kharanide benda. Hhende shidunne zhouzhi wila gie!'"
Zuihoude Panjiku
"Kunnikewon qienxienlare man hhantu goya fama dunda irekude hhe famatu baozo jierene soune.
Duyani soyuji minzulai hhei melie hhantulaghazhi hhe hhelai fenji keighane. Hoxian ghoni adulachen ghoni, imanyi fenji keighakui xianli.
Ghonilai borun miendene teine, imanlai soghei miendene teine.
Ingie honshan borun mienne kunlade kieliene, 'Adami fuqi ogisan kunla, irendu. Duyai zhayaghazhi iresanse tande zhunbei giesan gojiani jienliendu.
Bi oliesukude ta made ijieghazho, undasukudei made ochighazho. Bi chumen giekude ta mii soughazho.
Bi hulan muchughun bikude ta made musighazho. Bi giemerekude ta mii ushilazho. Bi bafanzideshi ta mii uzhele irezho.'
Gou kunla kieliene, 'Ezhan, bijien yan xienzide chi oliesusei chanladene chade ijieghazhi undasusei chanladene chade ochighawo?
Yan xienzide chumen giesei chanladene chii soughazhi hulan muchughun bikude chade jien musighawo?
Pse chi yan xienzide giemeresei chanladene ushilazhi bafanzideshi chii uzhele irewo?'
Honshan kieliewo, 'Bi tande shuhua kielieye, ta enezighan mii gaijiu dunda zui ganide oluzhi giese made oluzhi giezho.'"
"Ingie honshan soghei mienne kunlade kieliene, 'Ta ene kharasan kunla, yola. Ibilisi, Ibilisii hojilade zhunbei giesan ulie xinieku khande oro!
Bi oliesukude ta made ese ijieghazhi undasukude made ese ochighawo.
Bi chumen giekude ta mii ese soughawo. Bi hulan muchughun bikude made ese musighawo. Bi giemerekude ta mii ese ushilazhi bafanzideshi ta mii uzhele ese irewo.'
Hhelaye kieliene, 'Ezhan, bijien yan xienzide chi oliesusei, undasusei, chumen giesei, hulan muchughun bikui, giemeresei, bafanzide bikui chanlazhi ese banman giewo?'
Honshan kieliene, 'Bi tande shuhua kielieye, ta enezighan kun dunda zui ganide ese oluzhi giese made oluzhi ese giezho.'
Enezighan kunla chanqi faikude orone, gou kunla chanqi amitukude orone."
